source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U12: Map establishment, territorial notification, staffing and continuity of proceedings

facts.statement: CentralGovernment establishes DRT/DRAT by notification and jurisdiction; single PresidingOfficer/Chairperson,staff/recovery officers; cross-charge notification; vacancies permit statutory continuation from prior stage.

payload.title: Identify the forum from its notification and role
payload.core_explanation_md:
DRT and DRAT are separately established through the stated Central Government notification framework. The DRT is headed by the Presiding Officer and the appellate institution by its Chairperson; the staff and Recovery Officer perform supporting or execution functions rather than becoming extra adjudicating members. Territorial competence should be traced to the applicable notification.

Cross-charge arrangements and filling a vacancy do not automatically require every pending matter to restart. The statutory continuity provision identifies how proceedings continue. Keep the appointment instrument, jurisdiction and stage record together so an administrative change is not mistaken for a fresh trial or a transfer order.

self_check.prompt_text: Does replacing a Presiding Officer itself prove that every pending matter starts again?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Apply the statutory continuity rule and actual proceeding record.

payload.stem_md: A DRT staff roster is treated as evidence that the Tribunal is a multi-member judicial bench. What is the correction?

options.text_md: Every staff member has an adjudicating vote
options.explanation_md: Administrative staffing does not change the described composition.

options.text_md: The Recovery Officer automatically replaces the Chairperson of DRAT
The borrower may choose the number of adjudicators
options.explanation_md: Composition is established by law, not party preference.

options.text_md: Separate the single adjudicating office from supporting and recovery staff
options.explanation_md: The source distinguishes composition from staffing.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The source distinguishes composition from staffing.

options.text_md: The assumption that all earlier evidence vanished
options.explanation_md: Personnel change does not itself erase the record.

options.text_md: The appointment/continuity provisions and stage already reached
